release.notes: Live stream 1h is now in the Service menu: share a one-hour diagnostic recording (includes the VIN and phone location) to help improve support for your car. Safety: the live stream never tries extra registers on the BMW brake unit (DSC) or the MG IM5 vehicle control unit. Reconnecting reads the car identity again, so a shared adapter no longer carries the previous car's VIN. XPeng tyre pressures removed (unreliable). MG ZS EV 51 odometer from the gateway.
